claim_scope: Generated codec consistency for DWG LTYPE Shapeflag to DXF group 74 text/shape bits; no physical producer or native rendering claim.

authorities.name: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authorities.finding: DWG Shapeflag bit 2 identifies shape-number codes; bit 4 identifies string-area offsets. A later R2007+ sentence in the same ODA section says 0x02 for area presence, conflicting with the field definition; this discrepancy is retained explicitly.

authorities.name: Autodesk DXF LTYPE reference
authorities.finding: DXF group 74 bit 2 identifies embedded text and bit 4 identifies an embedded shape.

authorities.name: GNU LibreDWG public dwg.h source reference
authorities.finding: Dwg_LTYPE_dash documents bit 2 as shape number and bit 4 as strings_area index; has_strings_area is set when any shape_flag has bit 4, with the source comment identifying the conflicting ODA wording as a bug.

implementation.mapping: Swap bits 2 and 4 at DWG codec boundaries; keep DRW_LTypeSegment and DXF-facing callbacks in group-74 semantics. Raw DWG bit 4 controls presence of the R2007+ string area.

generated_controls.coverage: Across all direct DWG writer versions, independently inspect raw flag bits: DXF text bit 2 encodes as DWG bit 4; DXF shape bit 4 encodes as DWG bit 2.
Generated DWG text-area tests and shape-only tests write and read back normalized flags, text and shape code for AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027 and AC1032.

integration_ctest.result: object_vectors passed; broad local_roundtrip failed 359 unrelated assertions across existing material/output, DXF topology and polygon-mesh profiles. The new LTYPE-specific selector passes independently.
integration_ctest.limitation: This broad test's failures were not established as baseline in a clean checkout and are recorded without attributing them to this change.

not_established: native complex linetype rendering or shape-font selection
evidence_limits: The bit mapping is supported by ODA field semantics, Autodesk DXF group 74 semantics and LibreDWG implementation documentation. No real producer fixture with complex LTYPE text/shape was independently qualified in this slice.
